hero.editor_body:
There is an intelligence in emptiness that our screens have forgotten. To write is first to excavate — removing the superfluous until the sentence breathes on its own, without artificial support.

Clarity is not imposed. It reveals itself, slowly, like light filtering through the fog of our accumulated thoughts.

The blank page is not a threat. It is an invitation.
